list.title: Shy-Drager Syndrome (MSA):
list.snippet: This is a rare, neurodegenerative disease affecting the nervous system, causing symptoms similar to Parkinson's disease.

list.title: Autonomic Neuropathy:
list.snippet: This condition involves damage to the nerves that control involuntary bodily functions like breathing, heart rate, and digestion. It is often associated with diabetes.

list.title: Diabetes:
list.snippet: Cash also suffered from diabetes, which can cause nerve damage and contribute to autonomic neuropathy.

list.title: Other health issues:

list.title: Final Diagnosis:
list.snippet: Ultimately, his health problems were attributed to complications from diabetes and autonomic neuropathy.
